wire.headline: Northgate Port Authority Launches Major Expansion
sentences: The Northgate Port Authority has approved an expansion plan valued at 4.26bn GBP.
A board vote in March 2027 secured the decision with a 12% majority.
CEO Julian Vane cited rising transatlantic cargo demand as a primary driver for the project.
The stock price surged by 12.4p following the announcement.
The expansion targets the creation of 4,800 new jobs in Deeside.
Phase one construction is scheduled to begin on 4 November.
The funding package includes a 310m GBP government grant.
The market reaction was positive, with the index up 2.1%.
